BOOK_HINT: Right-click a tool, then left-click its targets. It activates when all targets are chosen. Right-click again or press Esc to cancel.

TIP.CHANT.title: Chant
TIP.CHANT.description: X is Chant intensity. Choose an available slot and consume Mana from its pile to activate its factor. Concentration and other effects modify the cost; selection shows the actual amount.
TIP.LEGENDARY.title: Legendary Spell
TIP.LEGENDARY.description: Playable after you have played a Chant card this turn.
TIP.DIVINITY.title: Mantra & Divinity
TIP.DIVINITY.description: Every 10 Mantra are consumed to enter Divinity and gain 3 Energy. Divinity triples attack damage until your next turn.
TIP.MANA_PAYMENT.title: Mana Payment
TIP.MANA_PAYMENT.description: Pay Mana equal to the normal Energy cost, from Draw, Hand, then Discard. Insufficient Mana prevents play. X-cost cards still consume Energy.
TIP.SEALED.title: Sealed
TIP.SEALED.description: Removed from the pile at combat start. Play 5 Chant cards in one turn to release it into your Hand.
TIP.SECOND_DEFENSE.title: Defensive Follow-up
TIP.SECOND_DEFENSE.description: Costs 0 Energy and Exhausts. Chant 1 and gain the same Block as the Defensive Magic that created it, retaining its upgrade.

PROP.CrystalBall: Swap the slots of two equipped factors.
PROP.MysteryBox: Gain two random factors (excluding puzzle factors) in your unequipped inventory.
PROP.MysticBox: Choose three unequipped factors and equip them in random slots. Return the previous factors to inventory.
PROP.SeinNote: Remove two unequipped factors or other tools. Heal 10 HP.
PROP.ShadowDragonHorn: Combat only. Remove two unequipped factors or other tools. Gain 2 Energy.
PROP.TransmutationCircle: Transform two factors into random factors of the same rarity (excluding puzzle factors), keeping their slots.
PROP.UnbelievableTool: Swap an equipped factor with an unequipped factor. Keep the previous factor in inventory.
PROP.UnbelievableToolBox: Remove two unequipped factors or other tools. Gain two Unbelievable Tools.
PROP_UNAVAILABLE: Unavailable: check target requirements and the current combat phase.
FACTOR_HINT: X is Chant intensity. Use tools to change equipped factors; each slot uses its own pile's Mana.
NO_PROPS: No tools yet. Choose Magic Shop at a camp to acquire two tools.
PROP_USED: Tool consumed. Factors and inventory updated.
PROP_CANCELLED: Cancelled or invalid targets. Tool not consumed. Follow the target requirements.
PROP_ERROR: An error occurred. Please check the game log.
SHOP_SELECT: Choose {Amount} tools. Confirm to spend this camp action, or cancel to return.
PROP_SELECT: Use {Prop}: choose {Amount} targets. Cancel without consuming the tool.
CRAFT.ManaDraw: Shuffle {Amount} Mana into your draw pile.
CRAFT.ManaDiscard: Add {Amount} Mana to your discard pile.
CRAFT.RandomCard: Add {Amount} random Common cards to your hand. They cost 0 this turn.
CRAFT.Retain: Choose {Amount} cards in your hand to Retain.
CRAFT.ZeroCost: Reduce the cost of {Amount} random cards in your hand to 0 this turn.
CRAFT.Execute: If the enemy has {Amount} HP or less, kill it.
CRAFT.UpgradeHand: Upgrade all cards in your hand.
CRAFT.UpgradeAll: Upgrade all non-Exhausted cards in combat. Exhaust.
TIP.SYNCHRO.title: Synchro
TIP.SYNCHRO.description: Play Mana to draw 1 card, then Exhaust that Mana. Frugality makes you discard it instead.
TIP.ACCELERATED_SYNCHRO.title: Accelerated Synchro
TIP.ACCELERATED_SYNCHRO.description: Synchro draws 2 cards. Ultimate Synchro still deals its damage.
TIP.ULTIMATE_SYNCHRO.title: Ultimate Synchro
TIP.ULTIMATE_SYNCHRO.description: Synchro deals 15 damage to a random enemy instead of drawing. Accelerated Synchro can still draw cards.
TIP.BACKFIRE.title: Backfire
TIP.BACKFIRE.description: After this card is played, it costs 1 more Energy this turn.
BOOK_VIEW_ONLY: View your factors and tools while choosing cards. Close this screen to continue your selection.
